exposure: Uterine artery pulsatility index (left and right)
New placental pulsatility index (calculated as (umbilical artery pulsatility index + mean of the left and right uterine artery pulsatility indices)/2)
cohort: The study included 53 low-risk pregnancies for establishing reference ranges and 340 pregnancies with suspected intra-uterine growth restriction for testing the index's predictive ability.
finding: The new placental pulsatility index demonstrated higher sensitivity and comparable specificity in predicting adverse outcomes in pregnancies suspected of intra-uterine fetal growth restriction compared to conventional umbilical and uterine artery pulsatility indices.
gest_age: 20-40 weeks of gestation for the reference group, and pregnancies suspected of intra-uterine growth restriction (IUGR) for the prediction group.
